applies_to: The future reviewed A-long large-cap batch signal-search execution package that may be executed only after independent review and explicit user execute.
does_not_authorize: No signal-search run is authorized by this ledger before independent review and an explicit user execute command.

No reinterpretation of any prior falsified or research-only-clue result, no old-result reslice, no relabeling a prior diagnostic as a pass, no factor-definition search, no factor-count search, no trailing-window search, no q-threshold search, no composite-weight search, no dropping losing factors then re-running FDR, no production use, no ship-gate evidence, no full-size manual use, no provider expansion, no DataHub work, and no broker / order automation.

No new daily_basic pull, daily-bar pull, or provider call is authorized; this design reuses the already-reviewed top-500 materialization, audit, and full-main-board PIT fundamentals (income / balancesheet / cashflow / daily) plus the restatement exclusion list.

creation_reason.reason: Five prior A-long large-cap singletons are spent and closed (full-main-board no_alpha; pure-quality falsified; cash_conversion clue-not-tradeable; low_volatility falsified; ep_value falsified). Sequential singletons control within-factor but not across-factor multiple testing and burn one round each. This new singleton ledger protects ONE pre-registered batch that tests nine diverse large-cap-robust factors + a frozen composite under BH-FDR — the agreed LAST structured candidate-generation round. It reuses the reviewed top-500 universe + full-main-board PIT fundamentals (no new fetch); BH-FDR controls within-batch family-wise error but cannot uncount the five prior spent singletons, so a survivor is the program-level (5+k)-th test and still requires forward-live validation.

budget_policy.spend_rule: The first reviewed A-long large-cap batch signal-search execution spends one planned test regardless of how many factors survive FDR; the whole batch is one pre-registered test.
budget_policy.no_silent_rescue_rule: If the batch is dry or only diagnostics pass, do not rerun with changed factor definitions, factor count, trailing windows, universe N, market-cap field, neutralization, holding period, benchmark, top fraction, cost model, q threshold, sub-period rule, composite weights, or risk-gate threshold, and do not drop losing factors and re-run FDR on the survivors, without a new reviewed preregistration and ledger update.

planned_tests.design_summary: One pre-registered batch of nine primary factors + one frozen family-equal-weight composite, each scored on the frozen primary cell (industry+size-neutral, equal-weight, 504d vs CSI300, top-500 PIT circ_mv universe with the reviewed 000043 exclusion). Across-factor decision = Benjamini-Hochberg FDR over the ten primary p-values at q=0.10 (research-clue gate), q=0.05 reported as a stricter diagnostic. A factor is a research-only clue only if it survives FDR AND passes the per-factor gates (positive mean net excess, both median sub-period halves positive, name/year concentration guards); a survivor is additionally a tradeable candidate only if its rolling-overlapping relative-NAV drawdown vs CSI300 is >= -15%. Diagnostics (252d, CSI1000, non-neutral, cap-weighted) cannot rescue. Reuses the vetted measurement chain + full-main-board PIT fundamentals; fetches nothing. The agreed last structured batch: if no factor survives, downgrade A-share large-cap in-sample alpha rather than rescue with new definitions.
review_boundary: This planned test is not authorized to run until Codex independent review PASS, Claude commit, and a separate explicit user execute.
No new data fetch, provider call, daily-bar pull, DataHub work, production claim, ship-gate evidence, full-size use, or broker / order automation is authorized.

If executed and no factor survives FDR with the robustness gates, treat the batch as dry under the frozen rules and follow the stopping rule (downgrade / forward-live / pivot); no rerun, definition / trailing-window / q / threshold / horizon / benchmark / universe change, no dropping losers then re-FDR, and no diagnostic rescue without a new reviewed preregistration and ledger.

Even a surviving in-sample clue is research-only and routes to forward-live validation, not production or ship-gate evidence; BH-FDR cannot uncount the five prior spent singletons, so a survivor is the program-level (5+k)-th test.
